tools.name: repo_map
tools.description: Get the module path, package tree, exported symbols and FX providers. Call this first in an unfamiliar repository. Pass package to see one directory in full.

package.description: Directory to expand in full, e.g. 'handler'. Omit for the whole tree.

max_tokens.description: Budget for the map. Defaults to 4000.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a slice of one file. Always pass start and end when you know roughly where to look; whole-file reads crowd out everything else in context.

tools.name: search_repo
tools.description: Search file contents by regular expression. Use this instead of grep, and prefer it over reading files to find something.

max.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 40.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the n-api-template knowledge base for the contract rule behind a pattern. Use it before inventing an approach, not after.

query.description: What you need to know, e.g. 'repository timeout constants'.

tools.name: go_symbols
tools.description: Find a symbol's definition, references or package API through gopls. Use this rather than searching for a name textually.
tools.unavailable: gopls is not yet wired (Part A section 8.3). Use search_repo, or go_build for type errors.
tools.instead: use search_repo for a textual search

tools.name: go_diagnostics
tools.description: Type-check the workspace incrementally and report errors. This is the fast inner-loop signal; run it after every edit batch.

path.description: Narrow to one file. Omit for the whole workspace.

tools.unavailable: gopls is not yet wired (Part A section 8.3). Use go_build, which is authoritative but takes about four seconds.
tools.instead: use go_build, which is authoritative but slower

tools.name: rules_lint
tools.description: Check Go against the n-api-template contract: layer boundaries, handler signatures, repository idiom, FX registration. Pass paths to scope it.

paths.description: Comma-separated paths to lint. Omit for the whole workspace.

tools.name: legacy_audit
tools.description: Detect pre-template patterns in an existing service: routes.go, gin, hand-rolled SQL builders, manual validation. Run before migrating; then search_docs 'legacy migration' and follow that SOP.

paths.description: Comma-separated paths to audit. Omit for the whole workspace.

tools.name: db_roundtrip_audit
tools.description: Profile every repository method: database calls, any inside a loop, batched, in a transaction, with a verdict. Worst first. Use before optimising by eye.

tools.name: validation_audit
tools.description: List every request field, its validate tag, and what the tag leaves unbounded. `required` alone means only 'not empty', so a 10MB string passes.

tools.name: temporal_audit
tools.description: List inline work that may belong off the request path: uploads, SMS, email, reports, outbound calls. Candidates only — it makes no recommendation.

tools.name: lib_version_check
tools.description: Report CEPT library drift: which are behind, which are superseded by n-api-*. Reports only — never edit go.mod on it, tell the user.

tools.name: playbook
tools.description: Get the known-good fix procedure for a failure class or rule id. Consult this before attempting a fix you have not made before.

rule.description: Rule id or failure class, e.g. 'fx-registration' or 'pgx-no-rows'.

tools.name: submit_plan
tools.description: Submit the plan and start the work. Each step names one file, what changes in it, and how you will know it worked.

steps.description: The steps, in order. At most eight.

file.description: Workspace-relative path this step changes, e.g. 'handler/pension.go'.

action.description: What changes in it, in one sentence.

accepts.description: How this step is checked once done.

summary.description: One sentence on what the whole plan achieves.

tools.name: ask_developer
tools.description: Stop and ask, when something cannot be inferred. Use only for what you genuinely cannot decide: field types, a table name, a route base.

questions.description: The questions, at most four. One decision each.

assumed.description: What you inferred rather than asking about.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: End your turn and hand the developer your answer. Call this when the work is done, or when going further will not help.

answer.description: What you found or did, in full. This is what they read.

blocked.description: What stopped you, if anything did. Omit when nothing did.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file. Refuses to overwrite an existing one — use patch_file for that. Write complete, compiling Go, not a sketch.

path.description: Workspace-relative path for the new file.

tools.instead: use patch_file to change a file that already exists

tools.name: patch_file
tools.description: Replace an exact unique string in a file. Include enough surrounding lines to make old unique; the call fails rather than guessing.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to change.

old.description: Exact text to replace, unique within the file.

tools.instead: use write_file to create a file that does not exist yet

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file. Always needs the developer's approval; say why in reason.

reason.description: One sentence on why it should go.

tools.name: gofmt
tools.description: Format Go files and fix their imports. Runs automatically after edits; call it directly only to clean up a file you did not just touch.

paths.description: Comma-separated paths. Omit for files changed this session.

tools.name: resource_scaffold
tools.description: Write a whole CRUD resource — domain, DDL, repository, DTOs, handler — from a field spec. Produce the spec; the templates produce the code.

tools.name: project_scaffold
tools.description: Create a new n-api-template service in an empty directory, with configs, bootstrap and one working resource. Credential fields are left empty.

resource.description: One resource to seed the service with, same shape as resource_scaffold.

tools.name: fx_wire
tools.description: Register a repository or handler in bootstrap/bootstrapper.go with the right annotations. Run this after adding either, or FX fails at startup.

tools.name: govalid_gen
tools.description: Regenerate handler/request/request_*_validator.go from the request structs. Run it whenever a validate tag changes; never hand-edit the generated files.

tools.name: go_build
tools.description: Build every package. This is the authoritative signal: nothing is done until it is clean, whatever the other tools say.

tools.name: go_vet
tools.description: Run go vet. Pass pattern to scope it to one package; unscoped it takes about thirty seconds, so never run that in the edit loop.

tools.name: go_test
tools.description: Run tests. Pass pattern to scope to one package when output is large.

tools.name: golangci_lint
tools.description: Run golangci-lint if the repository configures it. Advisory: its findings never block, so do not spend turns on them.

tools.name: govulncheck
tools.description: Scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities. Run it on a new service and after any dependency change, not routinely.

tools.name: swagger_check
tools.description: Check that routes are named and swagger generation is enabled, so endpoints reach /docs/v3Doc.json. This checks; it does not generate.

paths.description: Comma-separated paths to check. Omit for the whole workspace — but the gate always scopes it, so a legacy service's other handlers do not block a change that never touched them.

tools.name: go_mod
tools.description: Run tidy, or add a dependency. Tidy is free and must be a no-op at the gate; adding a direct dependency needs approval.

pkg.description: Module path, for get and why.

version.description: Version for get, e.g. 'v1.4.0'. Omit for latest.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: List changed, staged and untracked files. Cheap; use it to confirm what you changed.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show the diff of the working tree, or of one path. Read this before claiming a change is done.

path.description: Limit the diff to one path.

staged.description: True to diff the index instead of the working tree.

tools.name: git_blame
tools.description: Show who last changed each line of a file, and when. Use it to date a legacy pattern.

tools.name: git_ops
tools.description: Stage, commit, or switch to the session branch. Never pushes and never rewrites history, so nothing here can lose committed work.

paths.description: Comma-separated paths for add. Omit to stage tracked changes.

tools.name: run_terminal
tools.description: Run one allow-listed binary with explicit arguments. There is no shell, so no pipes, globs or redirection. Prefer a purpose-built tool.

argv.description: Command and arguments, JSON array, e.g. '["go","env","GOPRIVATE"]'.

timeout.description: Seconds before it is killed. Defaults to 60.
